pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with pixel-level edge gradients that are generally smooth with localized angularity. Individual patch area is greatest on the upper flank and neck, transitioning to significantly smaller, more fragmented geometries on the lower belly and hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous negative-space graph of light-colored pelage. Junction nodes are clearly defined with 3-way and 4-way intersections. Pathway thickness is greater on the neck and upper shoulder, narrowing to fine lines on the posterior flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible mane along the upper neck exhibiting a high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette against the background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A localized, dark, nodular mass is visible in the posterior ventral region near the junction of the belly and hind leg.
